title: Publish structured security evidence and autonomous repair dispatch
goal: Make security failures inspectable without privileged Actions logs and make Grok-created repair issues machine-routable through zero-token polling into Hermes Kanban and the Codex coder worker without weakening any gate.
definition_of_done: Frontend npm audit and container scans publish stable machine-readable evidence before enforcing failure.
Security evidence includes exact advisory or CVE, package/component, severity, installed or affected version and fixed version where the scanner exposes it.
Security gates remain fail-closed when HIGH/CRITICAL findings or scanner errors exist.
Evidence is retained as GitHub Actions artifacts and job summaries for independent review and is stamped with the exact pull-request head SHA.
An explicit dispatch contract routes eligible ai-os-repair issues to hermes:ai-company-governed, coder and openai-codex.
A deterministic GitHub issue ingester can create idempotent Hermes Kanban repair cards assigned to coder without an LLM routing turn.
A one-time installer can place the ingester into the ai-company-governed profile and schedule it every five minutes using Hermes no-agent cron.
Founder-gated or non-Codex repair issues fail closed to AWAITING_APPROVAL.
Autonomous Hermes-to-Codex execution is not claimed proven until the installer runs on the actual Hermes host and a READY GitHub issue produces a real Kanban task/worker run.
No production, live Stripe, customer delivery, secret or permission state is changed by this task.
tests: GitHub Actions CI emits normalized frontend and container security artifacts on the exact PR head SHA
AI OS Governance validates the bridge files and publishes a fresh independent-review packet
On the Hermes host: tools/install_hermes_ai_os.sh creates/retains the no-agent cron and ingests READY issue #41/#42 into a real coder Kanban task
Fresh independent Grok review evaluates the new exact commit SHA
